title: Commercial Credit Rate Notice: Fleet Late Balance Fee Rate by Payment Standing
content:
**Applies to:** Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement. Monthly rate of the fleet late balance fee.
**Records read:** the buyer's account with Service Accounts and Repair Orders (its tier and status) and the returned-payment entries on that service ledger.

**Rate clause.** The monthly rate follows the buyer's payment standing.
1. A buyer holding a Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or a Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 in active status, whose service ledger shows no returned payment in the last 24 whole months before the handling date, pays **1 percent (0.01) per month**.
2. A buyer holding such an account in active status, whose service ledger shows one or more returned payments in those 24 whole months, pays **1.75 percent (0.0175) per month**.
3. For every other buyer, no payment-standing rate applies.

**The 24-month window.** A service ledger entry falls in the last 24 whole months when fewer than 24 whole calendar months have passed from its ledger date to the handling date. A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

### Rate table

| Service account (Service Accounts and Repair Orders) | Returned payments on the service ledger, last 24 whole months | Monthly rate |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15, active | none | 1 percent |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30, active | none | 1 percent |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15, active | one or more | 1.75 percent |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30, active | one or more | 1.75 percent |
| any other tier, an account not in active status, or no service account | any | no payment-standing rate |

### Window boundary (hypothetical dates)
- Handling date 15 June of a given year; a returned service payment dated 16 June two years earlier. Only 23 whole months have passed, because the 16th has not yet been reached in the 24th month. The return counts, and the rate is 1.75 percent.
- Same handling date; a returned payment dated 15 June two years earlier. 24 whole months have passed. The return falls outside the window, and with no other return the rate is 1 percent.

### Basis Q&A
- *Does the count depend on how many returns there were?* No. One returned payment in the window places an active Net 15 or Net 30 buyer at 1.75 percent, and so does any larger number.
- *Does a Commercial Fleet Account in a status other than active earn either rate?* No. Both rates require the account to be in active status.
